title: Local algebra and dimension comparison for a polynomial chart
statement: Let T be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme; def-weil-affine-spectrum], let f:X\to T be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and let U be an affine open of X. Let e:U\to\mathbb A^n_T [def-nagata-relative-affine-space] be locally finitely presented and locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite], with projection composition equal to f restricted to U. For x in U put S equal to the stalk of f's fibre at the point represented by x [def-pc-scheme-fibre; def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. There exist a commutative ring R in the schemes' universe, a regular local ring structure on R [def-weil-regular-scheme], a local ring homomorphism \varphi:R\to S, and natural numbers d,r,t, such that S is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], \dim R=d, \dim S=r, \dim(S/\mathfrak m_R S)=0 [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], r\le d, the topological dimension at x of f's fibre is r+t [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point], n=d+t, and e's stalk map at x is flat if and only if \varphi is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Tags 00RE (dimension comparisons in the proof), 00R7, and 00RH (polynomial stalk and fibre stalk comparison), with the field dimension formula Tag 00P1; read 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Work in A = Gamma(T) and B = Gamma(U), with P = A[t_1,...,t_n]. The factorization is an A-algebra map P to B. The open immersion U into X induces open immersions of fibres and isomorphisms of their stalks; dimension at a point agrees with dimension at that point in an open subspace. Thus compute both invariants using B tensor_A kappa(p), where p is the contraction of the prime of x. Localization and tensor base change identify the fibre stalk and the source polynomial fibre local ring. Take R to be the polynomial fibre ring localized at the contracted prime, and transport the resulting local ring map to the actual fibre stalk S. The rings are in the same universe as the schemes; tensor products and localizations do not require a universe increase.

The polynomial local ring R is regular local. S is Noetherian local since the fibre coordinate algebra is finite type over the residue field of the base. Quasi-finiteness after base change gives a nonzero Artinian local closed fibre, whose dimension is zero. The quasi-finite local dimension inequality bounds dim(S) by dim(R). Name the finite local dimensions d and r. Apply the isolated-prime finite-residue theorem to the closed fibre to obtain a finite residue extension. The source and target residue fields therefore have the same finite transcendence degree t over the base residue field. Apply the finite-type field dimension-at-point formula to both coordinate rings. It gives fibre dimension r+t, while standard smooth polynomial n-space has dimension n at its image point, giving n=d+t. The open-fibre identification from the first step transports fibre dimension to the displayed point of f.fiber.

Flatness of the original polynomial stalk map survives base change to the base residue field and localization, hence implies flatness of the transported map phi. For the converse, use the local tower A_p to P_qprime to B_q. The two algebras are essentially finitely presented, the module B_q over itself is nonzero and finitely presented, and it is A_p-flat since f is flat and U is open. Its closed-fibre module is identified with S and its polynomial closed-fibre base with R. Apply the fibre criterion for flatness with M=B_q. This proves flatness of the original stalk map from flatness of phi. Ring isomorphisms preserve flatness, so the equivalence follows.

lean.statement:
theorem polynomial_chart_local_algebra
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] (f : X ⟶ T)
    [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (U : X.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] (n : ℕ)
    (e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation e] [LocallyQuasiFinite e]
    (he : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f)
    (x : U.toScheme) :
    let S := (f.fiber (f (U.ι x))).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber (U.ι x))
    ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsRegularLocalRing R)
      (φ : R →+* S) (_ : IsLocalHom φ) (d r t : ℕ),
      IsNoetherianRing S ∧
      ringKrullDim R = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      ringKrullDim S = (r : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      ringKrullDim (S ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map φ) = 0 ∧
      r ≤ d ∧
      topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber (U.ι x)) = ((r + t : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      n = d + t ∧
      ((e.stalkMap x).hom.Flat ↔ φ.Flat)
